Class MediaLabManager

java.lang.Object
gr.medialab.logic.MediaLabManager
public class MediaLabManager extends Object
Central application service that holds the in-memory state of the system and provides all operations required by the specification (users, categories, documents, versioning, watchlists, and persistence bridge).

Runtime rule: all operations modify only the in-memory state. Persistence is performed only at application shutdown through exportState().

    • addUser

      public void addUser(UserAccount admin, String firstName, String lastName, String username, String password, UserRole role, Set<String> allowedCategories)
      Adds a new user to the system (admin-only operation).

      Rules:

      • Username must be unique
      • Role is required
      • At least one allowed category is required
      • All allowed categories must exist in the system
      Parameters:
      admin - admin user performing the operation
      firstName - first name
      lastName - last name
      username - new username
      password - new password
      role - user role
      allowedCategories - categories the user can access
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if caller is not admin
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid input or unknown categories or duplicate username

    • deleteUser

      public void deleteUser(UserAccount admin, String username)
      Deletes a user from the system (admin-only operation).

      Rules:

      • The default admin medialab cannot be deleted
      • Watchlist/known-version state is removed for the deleted user
      Parameters:
      admin - admin user performing the operation
      username - username to delete
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if caller is not admin
      IllegalArgumentException - if username is blank, user not found, or default admin deletion attempted

    • updateUser

      public void updateUser(UserAccount admin, String targetUsername, String newFirstName, String newLastName, String newUsername, String newPassword, UserRole newRole, Set<String> newAllowedCategories)
      Updates an existing user (admin-only operation) without delete+add.

      Rules:

      • The default admin medialab cannot be modified here
      • Username may change, but must remain unique
      • At least one allowed category is required
      • All allowed categories must exist
      • If username changes, watchlist and known-version state is migrated
      Parameters:
      admin - admin user performing the operation
      targetUsername - current username of the user to update
      newFirstName - new first name
      newLastName - new last name
      newUsername - new username (may be same as targetUsername)
      newPassword - new password
      newRole - new role
      newAllowedCategories - new allowed categories
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if caller is not admin
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid input, unknown categories, user not found, or duplicate username

    • renameDocumentCategory

      public void renameDocumentCategory(UserAccount admin, String oldName, String newName)
      Renames a document category (admin-only operation).

      Side-effects:

      • Updates users' allowed categories
      • Updates documents that belong to the renamed category
      Parameters:
      admin - admin user performing the operation
      oldName - existing category name
      newName - new category name
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if caller is not admin
      IllegalArgumentException - if names are blank, old not found, or new already exists

    • deleteDocumentCategory

      public void deleteDocumentCategory(UserAccount admin, String categoryName)
      Deletes a document category (admin-only operation).

      Side-effects:

      • Deletes all documents that belong to the category
      • Removes the category from users' allowed categories
      • Removes deleted document ids from watchlists and known-version maps
      Parameters:
      admin - admin user performing the operation
      categoryName - category name to delete
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if caller is not admin
      IllegalArgumentException - if blank or not found

    • getVisibleVersionNumbers

      public List<Integer> getVisibleVersionNumbers(UserAccount user, Document doc)
      Returns the version numbers that are visible to a user for a given document.

      Rule:

      • USER: latest only
      • AUTHOR/ADMIN: latest + previous (2 total)
      Parameters:
      user - requesting user
      doc - target document
      Returns:
      list of visible version numbers (latest-first)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if user or document is null
      SecurityException - if user cannot access the document category

    • loginAndGetWatchedDocumentsWithNewVersion

      public List<Document> loginAndGetWatchedDocumentsWithNewVersion(UserAccount user)
      On user login, checks watched documents for updates and returns the ones that have a newer version than the user's last known version.

      After the check, the user's known-version map is updated to the current version.

      Parameters:
      user - logged-in user
      Returns:
      list of watched documents that have newer versions
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if user is null
